newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 edges up as SPT rises after H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 edges up as SPT rises after H1 results.

text.p: 0900 GMT - The Czech PX50 moves higher at Wednesday's fixing after SPT Telecom, the most heavily capitalised share on the bourse, releases first half results showing strong revenue growth.
* On PX50, 26 shares rise, 18 fall, six unchanged.
The Czech PX50 edged higher at Wednesday's fixing as the index's most highly capitalised share, SPT Telecom, posted moderate gains after announcing its first half financial results.

SPT said revenues had surged by 25 percent compared with the same period last year although increased depreciation charges led to sightly lower after tax profits of 2.79 billion crowns commpared with 2.82 billion.
"I think that the market will be happy with this and I think that there is a good potential for may be a little rise," said Lubomir Vystavel of ING Barings
